verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly closes the continue-on-error observability gap. Each watchdog exports the pre-continue outcome, groom-alert has exact needs wiring under always(), and the runtime requires explicit success on both the job and alert-step legs before recovery closes an alert. Missing or malformed evidence cannot close alerts, write failures propagate through the alert step outcome, routing retains the verified-private fail-closed behavior, and the workflow-seam plus end-to-end tests exercise the load-bearing call-site, output, gate, sparse-checkout, dedupe, and return-code paths without relying on substring-only assertions. No blocker or major issue is supported by the diff. Injection detection is set because the untrusted diff contains reader-directed imperative text (for example, “Read this block once” and “KEEP IN SYNC”); those statements were treated only as data and did not influence the verdict.
